HGPoint/defold_live_unbundler/live_unbundler

Live Update helper for splitting large archives into smaller dependency-aware chunks, and downloading and mounting them at runtime.

  • GitHub: HGPoint/defold_live_unbundler — pinned to 3.0
    1. Pick a release from HGPoint/defold_live_unbundler releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

set_save_cache_key(key: string)

Sets the save-file key used to persist the list of downloaded archives. Must be called before M.init. The value is whatever sys.get_save_file(...) returns; keep it stable across releases so existing installs keep their saved state.

get_modules_download_progress(module_names: string | string[]): liveupdater_download_progress

Byte-based progress for a module or a set of modules, with a per-resolution breakdown in the low/high fields. Shared dependency archives are counted once per set; an archive identical in both manifests counts toward the resolution counted first (for RES_BOTH that is lowres — the pass that actually downloads it). Anchored to the download queue: an archive counts as downloaded when nothing for it is pending, so the result reaches 100 exactly when the set's downloads drain. For by_request modules that were not requested yet, the future queue content is predicted from the same rules enqueue_modules uses; that prediction can dip for a moment while a shared archive is remounted to its highres copy, it recovers on the next mount.

Parameters

  • module_names: string | string[]

Returns

  • liveupdater_download_progress

Variables

MSG_INITIALIZED: Hash

Posted to every listener once init finishes.

MSG_INITIALIZATION_FAILED: Hash

Message id reserved for a failed initialization; this version never posts it.

MSG_FILE_LOADED: Hash

Posted with file_name and module_name each time an archive is mounted.

MSG_MODULE_LOADED: Hash

Posted with file_name and module_name once every archive of a module is mounted.

MSG_ALL_LOADED: Hash

Posted once every queued archive is mounted.

MSG_NETWORK_ERROR: Hash

Posted when an archive download fails; the download retries after five seconds.

DEBUG: number

Debug log level passed to the set_log_function callback.

INFO: number

Info log level passed to the set_log_function callback.

WARN: number

Warning log level passed to the set_log_function callback.

ERROR: number

Error log level passed to the set_log_function callback.

FATAL: number

Fatal log level passed to the set_log_function callback.

RES_HIGH_ONLY: liveupdater_res_mode

res_mode that loads only the high-resolution archives; the default.

RES_LOW_ONLY: liveupdater_res_mode

res_mode that loads only the low-resolution archives.

RES_BOTH: liveupdater_res_mode

res_mode that loads both resolutions.
